title: Population distribution
competency: Explain the factors of population distribution and locate densely and sparsely populated regions.

keywords.def: The way people inhabit and occupy the earth's surface.
A region with a large concentration of people.

ideas.name: Why people live where they live

en.text: Population distribution is the way people occupy the earth's surface. It is uneven. Physical factors are natural resources, topography and climate. Human factors are jobs and technology, politics, farming and transport, and social organization.

screens.title: Crowded and empty places
screens.ask: Why do many people live in the Ethiopian highlands but few in the Danakil desert?
opts: The highlands have better rain, soil and climate
People are not allowed in the desert
screens.after: Rain, fertile soil and a good climate attract people. Harsh deserts hold few people.

screens.title: 2.2.3 Population distribution
paras: Population distribution is the way people inhabit and occupy the earth's surface.
In general, the distribution of world population is uneven.
Its factors are of two groups: physical factors and human factors.

screens.title: Key words
defs: The way people inhabit and occupy the earth's surface.

screens.why: Physical factors come from nature; human factors come from people.
screens.clue: Did nature or people make it?

screens.text: The distribution of population in the world is uniform in all countries.
screens.why: The book says world population distribution is uneven.

screens.text: Which is a political factor of population distribution?
screens.why: Civil war and political unrest are political factors.
screens.clue: Politics is about government and conflict.

screens.text: A new factory opens in Adama and many people move there. Which kind of factor is this?
screens.why: Job opportunities are a socio-economic, human factor.
screens.clue: Who made the factory: nature or people?

en.text: Three belts are densely populated, called population clusters: the Asiatic belt with about 60% of the world's people, Peninsular Europe with 10.8%, and north-eastern North America with about 5%. Tundra, hot wet lands, hot dry lands, high relief and poor soils are sparsely populated.

screens.title: The biggest cluster
screens.ask: Which region holds about 60% of all the people in the world?
screens.after: The Asiatic belt, with China, Japan, India, Pakistan and Bangladesh, holds about 60%.

screens.title: 1. Densely populated regions
paras: There are three main belts of high population density. They are called population clusters.
table: East Asia: Japan, China. South Asia: India, Pakistan, Bangladesh.
Mainly the USA; highly urbanized and industrialized.

screens.title: 2. Sparsely populated regions
paras: Sparse areas have few people because conditions are not suitable for living.
They include tundra, hot wet lands, hot dry lands, high relief and areas with poor soil.
screens.note: Figure 2.4: a dot map, one dot = 1,000 people. Dots crowd in East and South Asia, Europe, the Nile valley and north-east USA.

screens.title: Key words
defs: A region with a large concentration of people.

screens.text: Which region is NOT sparsely populated?
screens.why: Peninsular Europe is a population cluster.
screens.clue: One option is a crowded belt.

screens.why: The three clusters are crowded; harsh lands are sparse.
screens.clue: Is it one of the three belts?

screens.ask: North-eastern North America holds about ___ % of the world's population.
screens.clue: It is the smallest of the three clusters.

screens.ask: If the world has 8,000 million people and the Asiatic belt has 60% of them, the belt has ___ million people.

items.text: 1. Why are some parts of the world crowded and others sparsely populated?
opts: Because of physical and human factors
Because of the size of the countries
items.ans: Because of physical and human factors
items.why: Resources, climate, topography, jobs and peace attract people.
items.clue: Recall the two groups of factors.

opts: The way people inhabit and occupy the earth's surface
The number of births in a year
items.ans: The way people inhabit and occupy the earth's surface

items.text: 3. Tap the natural (physical) factors that affect where people live.
items.why: Water, soil, rainfall and altitude come from nature. Jobs and roads are human factors.

test.text: Population distribution in the world is…
Which is a physical factor of population distribution?
The Asiatic population belt has about … of the world's population.
Tundra is a densely populated region.
Which country is in the South Asian part of the Asiatic belt?
test.why: South Asia: India, Pakistan, Bangladesh. Japan is East Asia.
